scope: Configuration readiness only; no automatic application, SDK or device installation.

applications.name: Codex Desktop
applications.purpose: Own configured MCP stdio processes and provide the desktop development workspace.
applications.version_policy: No version pin; validate the application identity. macOS native control requires separate validation.
applications.action: Install and sign in to Codex Desktop; run setup, review project trust explicitly and reload to validate MCP connectivity.

applications.name: Godot Editor
applications.purpose: Edit, run and validate the native GDScript game and animation labs.
applications.action: Install the official Godot 4.7.2 stable editor and select its executable or macOS application bundle.

applications.name: Adobe Photoshop
applications.purpose: Prepare reviewed art candidates through the Lunitora Photoshop UXP bridge.
applications.version_policy: >=27.10.0; UXP manifest v5 and Photoshop API v2
applications.action: Install Photoshop through Creative Cloud; install the reviewed UXP bridge and pair it privately.

applications.name: UXP Developer Tool (UDT)
applications.purpose: Adobe's developer utility for loading, developing and debugging the Lunitora UXP Photoshop plugin; not daily packaged-plugin use.
applications.action: Install UXP Developer Tool through Adobe Creative Cloud for developer plugin loading and git art-dev; enable Photoshop Developer Mode and select the repository plugin manifest.

prerequisites.name: Standalone Python
prerequisites.purpose: Run the setup/check commands, MCP toolkit and standard-library game regressions.
prerequisites.action: Install standalone Python 3.12 explicitly; setup detects it but never downloads or installs system Python.

prerequisites.name: Repository Python Environment
prerequisites.purpose: Provide the existing checkout-owned tools/lunitora_mcp/.venv environment without modifying system packages.
prerequisites.action: Explicit setup may create/install the repo environment; check is read-only and a valid existing environment is preserved.

prerequisites.name: Project MCP Configuration
prerequisites.purpose: Prepare only setup-owned direct-Python MCP entries while preserving user policy and inherited compatible entries.
prerequisites.version_policy: Godot nine reviewed tools; Photoshop three reviewed tools; project trust and live acceptance are separate
prerequisites.action: Run setup; review conflicting custom entries without replacing them. Explicitly review project trust and reload Desktop yourself.

prerequisites.name: Local MCP Authentication
prerequisites.purpose: Provision reviewed local Godot/Photoshop credentials only for configured capabilities; preserve valid protected credentials unless Photoshop replacement is explicitly requested.
prerequisites.version_policy: Existing project-bound Godot schema and Photoshop pairing-token format; Windows protected DACL; macOS REQUIRES MAC
prerequisites.action: Run setup for private one-time-per-machine Photoshop bridge pairing; hidden input accepts an existing token or generates a new protected token. Review unsafe storage explicitly; macOS authentication requires Mac validation.

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.purpose: Work with the current checkout and repository-local workflow aliases.
prerequisites.version_policy: No version pin; Git for Windows with Git Bash is the validated Windows workflow
prerequisites.action: Install Git; alias setup is local to this repository and never changes global Git configuration.

prerequisites.name: Node.js
prerequisites.purpose: Run the optional UXP JavaScript mock regression tests without npm packages.
prerequisites.action: Install Node only when running the JavaScript mock tests.

prerequisites.name: Git LFS
prerequisites.purpose: Fetch and version editable binary art only when the repository tracks those files with LFS.
prerequisites.version_policy: No version pin; conditional on LFS tracking
prerequisites.action: Install Git LFS before working with LFS-tracked masters; it is not required by the current text-only .gitattributes.

prerequisites.name: Java Development Kit
prerequisites.purpose: Build executable Android exports, not resource-package controls.
prerequisites.action: Install a compatible JDK and configure the user-local Java SDK path in Godot.

prerequisites.name: Android SDK
prerequisites.purpose: Build/install Android executables and inspect device availability.
prerequisites.version_policy: Godot 4.7: Platform-Tools >=35.0.0, Build-Tools 35.0.1, Platform 35, current Command-line Tools; documented native/custom-build packages include CMake 3.10.2.4988404 and NDK 28.1.13356709
prerequisites.action: Install the Android SDK with Android Studio or sdkmanager; accept licenses, configure Godot and authorize devices manually.

prerequisites.name: Godot Android Export Templates
prerequisites.purpose: Produce Android executables using templates matching the selected editor.
prerequisites.action: Install matching Godot export templates; resource-package validation alone does not prove executable export readiness.

prerequisites.name: Xcode
prerequisites.purpose: Build and sign executable iOS exports on a Mac.
prerequisites.version_policy: No repository version pin; full Xcode with the applicable iOS SDK is required
prerequisites.action: Install/open Xcode, accept licenses and select its developer directory; account, signing and provisioning remain manual.

prerequisites.name: Godot iOS Export Templates
prerequisites.purpose: Export the native iOS project with templates matching the selected editor.
prerequisites.action: Install matching iOS export templates; Apple team, bundle, certificates, profiles and device work remain explicit user setup.
